contract_deviations.description: Implementation uses addItemToNewOrExistingBasket (combined helper) instead of separate createBasket + addItemToBasket mutations as specified in the modal contract. Tests adapted to verify the combined helper is called with correct product items. Functionally equivalent — the combined helper handles create-or-add internally.

Implementation delegates add-to-cart confirmation modal opening to ProductView's internal handleCartItem (which calls onAddToCartModalOpen when addToCart returns data). Test verifies handleAddToCart returns selectionValues so ProductView can trigger the confirmation. Not directly asserting onOpen call since it's encapsulated in ProductView.

Chakra Modal's getDialogProps overwrites aria-labelledby passed on ModalContent when no ModalHeader is mounted. Test verifies the heading element with id='quick-view-modal-title' exists as a child of the dialog element. Dev session should consider adding ModalHeader or manually overriding Chakra's aria-labelledby handling for strict ARIA compliance.

escalations_to_dev_session: aria-labelledby on ModalContent is overwritten by Chakra's internal getDialogProps. Consider wrapping the heading in <ModalHeader> or applying a post-render aria-labelledby patch for strict accessibility compliance.
